spec.headline: PPC Strategy | Client Account Leadership | Tracking & Optimization
spec.headline_rationale: Blacksmith needs strategic ownership plus hands-on Google/Meta/Microsoft work, client recommendations, attribution and delivery quality. Use current source-supported agency account scale, channel management, measurement and process standardization.
spec.summary: Hands-on PPC strategist experienced in translating client goals into campaign plans, measurement and optimization. Managed more than 75 Google Ads accounts, consulted across paid search, display, remarketing, YouTube and social channels, and standardized an account system adopted across the agency. Pairs keyword and competitive research with GA4/GTM measurement, conversion tests and clear reporting. Experience evaluating bid strategies, incremental CPA, budgets and landing-page performance supports practical recommendations and accountable execution across a client portfolio.
spec.factual_review: Read exact Blacksmith PPC Strategist job and US remote eligibility. Supported E075/E076/E078/E081/E043/E079/E082/E002/E030/E095. Do not claim multifamily expertise, closing-rate gains or specific AE sales call history absent source.
spec.tools_rationale: Source-backed campaign execution, tracking, reporting and automation tools directly relevant to the PPC portfolio.
